legend: Polypoid stromal proliferation lined by squamous epithelium. The stroma is hypocellular, with somewhat increased cellularity centrally, in association with a few larger vessels.
Stellate to elongated stromal cells with delicate cytoplasmic processes, set in fine collagenous stroma. The stromal cells show occasional slightly enlarged, hyperchromatic, angulated nuclei.
Mono- and multinucleated stromal cells are positive for desmin (desmin immunohistochemical stain).
Mono- and multinucleated stromal cells are positive for CD34 (CD34 immunohistochemical stain).

Uniformly hypocellular proliferation of bland stromal cells with patchy modest nuclear enlargement and scant delicate cytoplasm, set in fine collagenous stroma with relatively abundant, variably dilated, mid-sized arterioles. Most stromal cells in this case are mononucleated. The stromal proliferation directly abuts the overlying squamous epithelium.

Polypoid stromal proliferation with modestly increased cellularity and larger-caliber vessels centrally. Multinucleated stromal cells with large, modestly hyperchromatic nuclei and relatively abundant cytoplasm and are most prominent just below the squamous epithelium.
